title: Nvidia's CEO Quit, Then Came Back in 11 Days
hook: In just eleven days, Nvidia's CEO quit and came back.
description: Jensen Huang resigned on Nov 12, the board said he was done, and 11 days later he was CEO again. Would you have brought him back? #nvidia #truestory #stockmarket #business #shorts

title: Nvidia Gained Almost $1 Trillion in One Day
hook: Nvidia just gained almost a trillion dollars in one day.
description: Nvidia's stock slid about a fifth while its CEO was gone, then jumped about 31% the day he came back. Is one CEO really worth that much? #nvidia #stockmarket #truestory #business #shorts

title: He Washed Dishes at Denny's. Now He Runs Nvidia
hook: He washed dishes at Denny's, and now he runs Nvidia.
description: Jensen Huang washed dishes at Denny's at 15, then planned Nvidia in a Denny's booth in 1993. What was your first job? #truestory #nvidia #business #history #shorts
